reason: The README describes a DSH Web plugin focused on navigating, recording, and restoring sent input history, with durable local-file persistence and support for associated attachments.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供上下键历史导航，并记录、恢复和持久化已发送的文本及相关附件引用。
summaries.en: Provides DSH Web input-history navigation with up and down keys, recording, restoring, and persisting sent text and related attachment references.

capabilities: Captures sent prompts and associated image or file references
Navigates previously sent input with up and down arrow keys
Persists input history in a user-directory JSON file through a host API
Uses localStorage as a synchronization cache
